q1.a: Jasa Proteksi is an insurance comparison platform operated by PT. Jasa Global Proteksi. We help you find the best vehicle protection from various leading insurance companies.

q2.q: Why should I use Jasa Proteksi?
q2.a: Jasa Proteksi helps you compare products from multiple insurance companies at once. You get more choices, advice from expert advisors, and easier claims process — all at no additional cost.

q3.q: How do I get vehicle insurance recommendations?
q3.a: Select the type of vehicle protection you need, fill in your vehicle information, and our system will display premium simulation and recommendations from various insurance partners. You can also consult directly with our advisor via WhatsApp.

q4.q: Is there a fee for consulting with an advisor?
q4.a: No, consultation with a Jasa Proteksi advisor is completely free. We are paid by the partner insurance companies, so you get professional advice at no additional cost.

q5.q: How does the claims process work?
q5.a: We accompany you from start to finish during the claims process. Contact us, and your advisor will help manage the entire process with the relevant insurance company.

q6.q: Which insurance partners work with Jasa Proteksi?
q6.a: We work with leading insurance companies in Indonesia including Sinarmas, ACA, Mega Insurance, Zurich Syariah, Tugu, OONA, MAG, and Sahabat. All our partners are licensed and OJK-supervised trusted insurance companies.
